records.title: I-ViT: Integer-only Quantization for Efficient Vision Transformer Inference
records.reason: Borderline transfer candidate: low-bit integer quantization is relevant to LLM inference, but the method is validated on ViT image classification/Turing Tensor Cores and may not preserve decoder language quality or map to LLM kernels. Follow up only with an LLM quantization/quality benchmark.

records.title: Baldur: Whole-Proof Generation and Repair with Large Language Models
records.reason: Although linked to serving/KV-cache work, the primary text’s intervention is a theorem-proving workflow combining generation and proof repair. It provides no latency, token, memory, or throughput reduction for LLM inference.

records.title: D4: Improving LLM Pretraining via Document De-Duplication and Diversification
records.reason: The primary abstract states a pretraining data selection objective, not an inference-time method or serving optimization.

records.title: AutoSkill: Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning via Skill Self-Evolution
records.reason: The existing persistent-memory lineage makes this worth retaining as borderline, but its stated objective is personalized capability accumulation. It adds query rewriting, retrieval, extraction/management, and skill injection; without a cost/quality comparison it cannot be treated as an inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: Cost Aggregation with 4D Convolutional Swin Transformer for Few-Shot Segmentation
records.reason: Its abstract and experiments target few-shot segmentation benchmarks; there is no LLM serving or inference-efficiency result.
